method.throughput: Separate whole-batch process, status/event counting and all-event checksumming; no per-command clocks or observers. Preload excluded from time.
method.latency: Full process-only diagnostic pass, two clock reads per command; histogram and conditional frequencies are exact and derived from the same pass.
method.observer: Independent STL order/level maps consume reports outside each process clock interval. Their memory access can affect caches of subsequent commands; diagnostic latency is not headline core latency.
method.levels_emptied: Observed levels losing their final resting order through maker fills or cancellations; replace can remove and recreate a level. No inferred internal scan or probe counts.
method.checksum_scope: Every field of every preload and measured execution report; measured events/trades exclude preload, complete final snapshots and statistics include preload.
method.engine_order: Rotate selected order by run index. Separate fresh book warmup before each pass.
method.timeline_sequence: Measured command index; zero is state after preload. Reference timeline/depth captures use a completely separate untimed pass.
